preconditions.description: The victim (owner) must have a positive balance of BNRG tokens to approve
Contract state must be Unlocked or Restricted (not Locked) to allow transfers

exploit_hint: Exploit the classic ERC20 approve race condition: 1) Get initial approval from victim (e.g., 100 tokens). 2) Monitor for when victim tries to change approval to a lower amount (e.g., 50 tokens). 3) When victim sends the second approval transaction, front-run it with a transferFrom for the original 100 tokens. 4) The second approval will still succeed, allowing you to transfer another 50 tokens. Result: You get 150 tokens instead of the intended 100.
